title.en: What Is a Concrete Pump in the Xingtai Catalogue?
title.zh: 邢台目录里的混凝土泵是什么？

description.en: What Is a Concrete Pump in the Xingtai Catalogue?
description.zh: 邢台目录里的混凝土泵是什么？

h1.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists concrete pumps as pipeline machines: electric, diesel and mixer units, including compact and tractor-driven rows.
h1.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把混凝土泵列为管道输送机器，包括电动、柴油、搅拌泵，以及紧凑型和拖拉机带动行。

directAnswer.en: A concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery is a pipeline machine built in Xingtai, Hebei. The catalogue groups electric concrete pumps, diesel concrete pumps and mixer pumps, and it includes compact frames plus a tractor-driven row. Each model page prints its own power, output, pressure and distance. A truck-mounted placing boom and a mixing plant are not listed. Spraying machines are a separate category.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台制造的混凝土泵，是沿管道输送混凝土的机器。目录分成电动混凝土泵、柴油混凝土泵和搅拌泵，并包含紧凑机型和拖拉机带动行。每一页各自印功率、产量、压力和距离。车载布料臂架和搅拌站不在目录里。喷涂机是另一个分类。

heading.en: Which machines count as concrete pumps here
heading.zh: 这里哪些机器算混凝土泵

body.en: Open /en/products/electric-concrete-pumps/, /en/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/ and /en/products/mixer-pumps/. Those hubs are the concrete pump families made by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 20 is a trailer row with a printed pipe. Electric 15 and Electric 10 are compact rows. B500S-83D is a two-stage compact unit. The Tractor-Driven 4100 and the rural diesel pump sit in the diesel hub. Mixer pages mix and pump on one trailer. They are not mixing plants.
body.zh: 请打开 /zh/products/electric-concrete-pumps/、/zh/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/ 和 /zh/products/mixer-pumps/。这三个分类是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵家族。电动20是印了管径的拖泵行。电动15和电动10是紧凑行。B500S-83D 是两级结构的紧凑机。拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵在柴油分类里。搅拌泵页是在同一拖车上搅拌并泵送，不是搅拌站。

heading.en: What a concrete pump page is for
heading.zh: 混凝土泵页面用来做什么

body.en: The page tells you the printed cells for that one machine: power source, theoretical output, pressure when a pressure row exists, and the distance labels that page actually uses. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print one distance that covers every concrete pump. Electric 80's 900 m / 300 m pair stays on the Electric 80 page. A spraying machine page is not a substitute pump page.
body.zh: 页面只说明这一台机器印出的格子：动力、理论输送量、有压力行时的压力，以及这一页实际使用的距离标题。河北品锦机械没有印一个覆盖全部混凝土泵的距离。电动80的 900 m / 300 m 只留在电动80页面。喷涂机页面不能代替泵的页面。

body.en: The catalogue does not list a truck-mounted placing boom. B500S-83D is the page that uses the word boom, and it says the short boom is on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Mixing plants are not a product line. Use /en/contact/ when a required figure is not printed. Do not fill it from another model.
body.zh: 目录没有车载布料臂架。使用“臂架”一词的是 B500S-83D，它写明短臂架在紧凑机上，不是车载布料杆。搅拌站不是产品线。需要的数字没有印出时，请用 /zh/contact/。不要从另一型号填进去。

question.en: Is a Pinjin concrete pump a truck boom?
question.zh: 品锦的混凝土泵是车载臂架泵吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists pipeline concrete pumps. The B500S-83D line says its short boom is not a truck-mounted placing boom.
answer.zh: 不是。河北品锦机械在邢台列出的是管道混凝土泵。B500S-83D 写明短臂架不是车载布料杆。

answer.en: Yes. The mixer-pump hub is part of the concrete pump catalogue. Those machines mix and pump on one trailer. They are not mixing plants.
answer.zh: 算。搅拌泵分类属于混凝土泵目录。这些机器在同一拖车上搅拌并泵送，不是搅拌站。

question.en: Does one output apply to every model?
question.zh: 一个产量能套到所有型号吗？

answer.en: No. Each concrete pump page from the Xingtai catalogue prints its own theoretical output. Read the page you intend to use.
answer.zh: 不能。邢台目录里每台混凝土泵都印自己的理论输送量。请读你打算使用的那一页。

answer.en: Spraying machines have their own category. They are not the trailer or compact concrete pumps described here.
answer.zh: 喷涂机有自己的分类。它们不是这里说的拖式或紧凑型混凝土泵。
